title: [Bugs] PFCP Session Establishment Request not handled by UPF

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

body:
## Describe the bug
When registering many UE’s (with UERANSIM), some are not registered. This is not systematic, but this always happens after some UE’s rebooting. Unregistered UEs are due to unhandled PFCP Session Establishment Request. These requests can be seen in PCAP traces but not UPF’s log.

## To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Start all NFs + gNB.
2. Start many UEs (e.g. 30).
3. Restart some UEs.

## Expected behavior
All UEs should be registered, and UPF should handle all PFCP Session Establishment Requests.

## Environment (please complete the following information):
 - free5GC Version: last version (b1172c3)
 - OS: Ubuntu server 20.04
 - Kernel version: 5.4.0-77-generic
 - go version: 1.14.4
 - UERANSIM version: v3.2.2
